name: Rotini Pasta with Pork Sausage, Mushrooms, Zucchini, Tomato & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb ground pork sausage
salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium zucchini squash
½ lb white mushrooms
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
When the sausage is done, add zucchini and mushrooms to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, and basil to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
